prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified.  Clothes should use medieval simple round-neck or tie-neck wool cuts, NOT modern lapels, tailored suit coats or collared shirts. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP ROSA adult woman winemaker with old family brand, proposed mature wavy dark hair with grey streak, muted plum wool dress and brown work apron, holding one small closed PLAIN clay wine flask without label, household worker not official merchant. MIDDLE TIO adult male returning WINEMAKING apprentice, young adult with chestnut short hair and no beard, dull olive round-neck tunic, pale work apron and trousers, boots, holding a small wooden tasting dipper EMPTY; he is NOT the separate cooper apprentice BELO, no barrel hoop or cooper hammer. BOTTOM MODA adult female traveling cookhouse purchaser, middle-aged dark hair under ochre kerchief, slate-blue dress with russet short cape, small CLOSED plain account folio against hip and modest belt purse, questioning posture. No new vintage claims, no falsified label legible, sale/refund, trademark transfer or resurrection of lost family members. All possessions review proposals only.
